title: Compiled Spatial Intent v9A.2
description: Masterpiece OS Space Generator Phase 9A.2 Spatial Intent Compiler Output. v9A.2 是 Spatial Intent Reasoning 的 compiler 层, 输入 spatialIntentDna (5 字段) 编译为 compiledSpatialIntent (5 字段). 规则只提供方向, 不直接生成视觉 (Phase 9A.2 §8). 不污染 Prompt Runtime (Phase 9A.2 §11).

experienceGoal.description: Phase 9A.2 §7.1: 描述最终空间体验目标. 例如 '创造低压力、高信任的专业医疗体验'.

spatialStrategy.description: Phase 9A.2 §7.2: 将情绪转换为空间策略. 例如 'controlled visibility / soft transition / calm circulation'.

architecturalImplications.description: Phase 9A.2 §7.3: 提供建筑方向. 不是固定形式. 正确 '需要连续边界和柔性空间关系'; 错误 '必须使用膜结构'.

functionRelationship.description: Phase 9A.2 §7.4: 连接功能需求. 例如 '咨询区域: 需要私密性 / 可见性平衡 / 信任建立'.

constraints.description: Phase 9A.2 §7.5: 记录禁止方向. 例如 'avoid excessive decoration / avoid entertainment atmosphere / avoid unrelated visual symbols'.

weight.description: Optional. Phase 9A.3 集成时, compiledSpatialIntent 对 prompt 编译时的强调强度. 0=不强调, 1=最强. Phase 9A.2 推荐 0.25 (与 architectureFunctionBridge.weightBoost 对齐).

frozen_by: Space Generator v1.1 Phase 9A.2 Spatial Intent Compiler

CAN: transform brand experience goal to spatial direction
output spatial strategy (controlled visibility, soft transition, etc.)
output architectural implications (high-level, not specific forms)
CANNOT: select specific architecture anchor (由 runtime/selectAnchors 负责)
specify material combinations (由 DNA.materialDna 负责)
copy reference images (由 anchor / calibration 负责)
